ra: Philosophical Sulphur is one of the tria prima grouped under the Alchemical Principles hub.
Philosophical Mercury is one of the tria prima grouped under the hub.
Philosophical Salt completes the Paracelsian tria prima under the hub.
The Alchemical King is a personified principle in the corpus, grouped under the hub.
The Alchemical Queen is a personified principle grouped under the hub.
The Rebis is a personified principle/goal-image grouped under the hub.
Azoth is a personified operative principle grouped under the hub.
The Green Lion is a personified emblem-principle grouped under the hub.
Sol/Rex and Luna/Regina are the royal pair whose marriage is the chymical wedding.
The Rebis is the hermaphroditic offspring born from the union of the King and Queen.
The Rebis is the hermaphroditic offspring of the King and Queen's coniunctio.
As the coniunctio of opposites, the Rebis embodies the reconciliation of the alchemical principles.
In the corpus Azoth is frequently identified with Philosophical Mercury as the universal transforming agent.
Sol/the King as the fixed solar masculine is read as the manifest form of the active Sulphur principle.
Luna/the Queen as the volatile lunar feminine is aligned with the volatile Mercury principle.
Philosophical Mercury (Mercurius) draws its name and authority from the Hermetic tradition of Hermes Trismegistus, the legendary father of the art; a reception, not identity (homonym noted).
Western alchemy frames itself as the Hermetic art received from Hermes Trismegistus, whose Emerald Tablet underwrites its principles.
The animating spirit sought in the alchemical opus is aligned in the Hermetic-alchemical corpus with the World Soul / Anima Mundi as the universal life-principle.
